svg.metadata: {"version":1,"title":"新加入的结点，不能继承连通块过去的加分","steps":[{"caption":"连接 1、2：合并本身不改变任何结点已有信息。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"parent":[0,1,1,3,4],"delta":[0,0,0,0,0],"tag":[0,0,0,0,0],"values":[0,0,0,0],"operation":[1,1,2]}},{"caption":"给 1 所在块增加 10，只改该块根标记，块内实际值一起增加。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"parent":[0,1,1,3,4],"delta":[0,0,0,0,0],"tag":[0,10,0,0,0],"values":[10,10,0,0],"operation":[2,1,10]}},{"caption":"给 3 所在块增加 5，只改该块根标记，块内实际值一起增加。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"parent":[0,1,1,3,4],"delta":[0,0,0,0,0],"tag":[0,10,0,5,0],"values":[10,10,5,0],"operation":[2,3,5]}},{"caption":"连接 4、1：合并本身不改变任何结点已有信息。 4 挂到 1，差值必须为 0−10=−10。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"parent":[0,1,1,3,1],"delta":[0,0,0,0,-10],"tag":[0,10,0,5,0],"values":[10,10,5,0],"operation":[1,4,1]}},{"caption":"给 2 所在块增加 2，只改该块根标记，块内实际值一起增加。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"parent":[0,1,1,3,1],"delta":[0,0,0,0,-10],"tag":[0,12,0,5,0],"values":[12,12,5,2],"operation":[2,2,2]}},{"caption":"连接 1、2：合并本身不改变任何结点已有信息。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"parent":[0,1,1,3,1],"delta":[0,0,0,0,-10],"tag":[0,12,0,5,0],"values":[12,12,5,2],"operation":[1,1,2]}},{"caption":"连接 2、4：合并本身不改变任何结点已有信息。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"parent":[0,1,1,3,1],"delta":[0,0,0,0,-10],"tag":[0,12,0,5,0],"values":[12,12,5,2],"operation":[1,2,4]}},{"caption":"给 2 所在块增加 1，只改该块根标记，块内实际值一起增加。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"parent":[0,1,1,3,1],"delta":[0,0,0,0,-10],"tag":[0,13,0,5,0],"values":[13,13,5,3],"operation":[2,2,1]}}]}
